evidence: Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and ci/test scripts to drop privileged container mode and remove BCC dependencies in ASan CI.
rationale: Dropping privileged container execution in ASan CI improves runner security and removes the BCC toolchain dependency. The change resolves a stated CI goal ('The ASan CI job no longer needs a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead'), though it remains secondary to the test framework rework.
